messages:
maria: Heads up — our sampleapp streaming demo fails behind the corp proxy. It looks like the keepalive ping is truncating the final SSE chunk, so client never gets the terminal event and the UI hangs.

sam: ugh. any logs/stack? is it specific to the node sdk or browser?

maria: Node sampleapp (express) + node SDK. Works fine when run locally. Fails when routed through the corporate LB that inserts TCP keepalives. Logs show last chunk length smaller than expected.

jin: can you paste the raw stream fragment from the proxy logs? also which sdk version?

maria: sdk v0.9.3. raw from proxy: ```data: {"choices":[{"text":"...token"}]}

:``` — see how last line cuts off after the blank line? the trailing final newline/last event is missing.

sam: That malformed final boundary would break the SSE parser which waits for a blank line to dispatch an event. Node SDK parser currently waits for "

" to flush buffer. If LB strips the last newline we never emit.

maria: Right. Repro is easy with curl and `--keepalive-time`.

jin: Short-term fix: SDK should treat connection close or EOF as implicit flush of any buffered data. We shouldn't wait for extra newline if socket ended. Can we patch that in 0.9.4?

sam: Agreed. Also add defensive timeout: if no new bytes for X ms after a partial event, emit partial (configurable). That helps flaky proxies.

ops: deploy-bot: patch branch created: fix/sse-eof-flush. CI/integ tests queued. :rocket:

maria: Thanks — can we also add a note in sampleapp readme about proxy keepalive pitfalls and a troubleshooting snippet? Onboarding folks keep hitting this and they assume model is stuck.

sam: yep. I'll add a short FAQ entry and a small script that simulates truncated keepalive so devs can reproduce locally.

jin: Also verify browser sdk behavior — fetch streams behave differently; ensure parity on EOF flush and timeouts. Add test matrix (node/browser/python).

maria: leaving logs and minimal repro in the PR. I'll ping integrations once CI passes. Thanks all.

devx-bot: CI status changed: build 4821 for fix/sse-eof-flush — tests running.

ops: deploy-bot: merged to main after green tests. Release note: "node/browser SDK: SSE parser now flushes partial events on EOF and adds configurable idle flush timeout; helps clients behind proxies that strip trailing newlines."
